title: Safer compiler and browser overlap
summary: Local build admission can run one compiler job and one browser suite together in separate worktrees when memory conditions allow.
details: Same-kind work and work using the same canonical checkout remain serialized. Desktop and Android packaging, unknown commands, and older guards remain exclusive.

Admission requires normal macOS memory pressure and at least 25% reported memory headroom. Synthetic subprocess tests cover overlap, exclusion, nesting, cancellation, legacy locks, and sccache ownership.

The whole web build holds its checkout lock. A guard-only installer updates the Cargo runtime atomically without restarting desktop services. Cleanup inspection found no eligible merged, idle build folders or worktrees.
Relay, native and timing-sensitive browser checks stay exclusive. Waiting for an older exclusive guard uses a bounded kernel wait instead of a polling race.
limitation: Real Clippy and browser integration checks are pending behind pre-existing exclusive work. No end-to-end speedup or physical-phone result is claimed.
